en.name: Paul I
en.summary: A pope, brother and successor to Stephen II, who continued close alliance with the Franks against ongoing Lombard threats to Rome.
en.body: Paul I, who had served his brother Stephen II as a close adviser, maintained the new Frankish alliance as Lombard kings continued to press on papal territory. He corresponded frequently with Pepin the Short seeking military and diplomatic support, and worked to translate the relics of numerous early martyrs from suburban catacombs into churches within Rome's walls for safekeeping.
